sys_hub_flow.description:
Generates a response from the model given an input prompt.

Inputs:

  • Model - The name of the model to use for generating the response.
  • Transaction ID - The transaction ID.
  • Content - Prompt object with the following fields for which the response is generated.
    • Role - The role in a conversation associated with the content. Acceptable values include USER, MODEL.
    • Text - The text instructions or chat dialogue to include in the prompt.
  • Safety Settings - A list of unique SafetySetting instances with following fields for blocking unsafe content.
    • Category - The category for this setting.
    • Threshold - Controls the probability threshold at which harm is blocked.
  • Generation Config - Object with following fields specifying the configuration for generating the response.
    • Temperature - Controls the randomness of selecting the next token during text generation. Lower values reduce randomness.
    • Top P - The maximum cumulative probability of tokens to consider when sampling.
    • Top K - The maximum number of tokens to consider when sampling.
    • Stop Sequences - The set of character sequences (up to 5) that will stop output generation.
    • Max Output Tokens - The maximum number of tokens to include in a candidate.
    • Candidate Count - The number of response variations to return. Value must be 1.
  • Enable Retry Policy - Set to true to enable the retry policy.

Outputs:

  • Content - The response object from the model with the following fields.
    • Role - The role in the conversation associated with the content.
    • Text - The generated text.
  • Finish Reason - The reason why the model stopped generating tokens.
  • Safety Ratings - An array of Safety Rating objects with the following fields.
    • Category - The safety category to configure a threshold for.
    • Threshold - The confidence scores of the each category, higher value means higher confidence.
    • Blocked - A flag indicating if the model's input or output was blocked.
  • Citation Metadata - Citation information for model-generated output.
    • Citations - List of citations to sources for a specific response.
      • Start Index - Start of segment of the response that is attributed to this source, measured in bytes.
      • End Index - End of the attributed segment, exclusive.
      • URI - URI that is attributed as a source for a portion of the text.
      • License - License for the GitHub project that is attributed as a source for segment.
      • Title - Title associated with this citation. If present, it refers to the title of the source of this citation.
      • Publication Date - Publication date associated with this citation. If present, it refers to the date at which the source of this citation was published.
  • Usage Metadata - Usage Metadata object with the following fields:
    • Prompt Token Count - Number of tokens in the request.
    • Total Token Count - Number of tokens in the request and response(s).
    • Candidates Token Count - Number of tokens in the response(s).
  • Action Status - An object with the following fields:
    • Code - If the request is executed successfully, code will be set to 0 but if the request failed, code will be set to 1.
    • Message - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.

sys_hub_flow_snapshot.description:
Generates a response from the model given an input prompt.

Inputs:

  • Model - The name of the model to use for generating the response.
  • Transaction ID - The transaction ID.
  • Content - Prompt object with the following fields for which the response is generated.
    • Role - The role in a conversation associated with the content. Acceptable values include USER, MODEL.
    • Text - The text instructions or chat dialogue to include in the prompt.
  • Safety Settings - A list of unique SafetySetting instances with following fields for blocking unsafe content.
    • Category - The category for this setting.
    • Threshold - Controls the probability threshold at which harm is blocked.
  • Generation Config - Object with following fields specifying the configuration for generating the response.
    • Temperature - Controls the randomness of selecting the next token during text generation. Lower values reduce randomness.
    • Top P - The maximum cumulative probability of tokens to consider when sampling.
    • Top K - The maximum number of tokens to consider when sampling.
    • Stop Sequences - The set of character sequences (up to 5) that will stop output generation.
    • Max Output Tokens - The maximum number of tokens to include in a candidate.
    • Candidate Count - The number of response variations to return. Value must be 1.
  • Enable Retry Policy - Set to true to enable the retry policy.

Outputs:

  • Content - The response object from the model with the following fields.
    • Role - The role in the conversation associated with the content.
    • Text - The generated text.
  • Finish Reason - The reason why the model stopped generating tokens.
  • Safety Ratings - An array of Safety Rating objects with the following fields.
    • Category - The safety category to configure a threshold for.
    • Threshold - The confidence scores of the each category, higher value means higher confidence.
    • Blocked - A flag indicating if the model's input or output was blocked.
  • Citation Metadata - Citation information for model-generated output.
    • Citations - List of citations to sources for a specific response.
      • Start Index - Start of segment of the response that is attributed to this source, measured in bytes.
      • End Index - End of the attributed segment, exclusive.
      • URI - URI that is attributed as a source for a portion of the text.
      • License - License for the GitHub project that is attributed as a source for segment.
      • Title - Title associated with this citation. If present, it refers to the title of the source of this citation.
      • Publication Date - Publication date associated with this citation. If present, it refers to the date at which the source of this citation was published.
  • Usage Metadata - Usage Metadata object with the following fields:
    • Prompt Token Count - Number of tokens in the request.
    • Total Token Count - Number of tokens in the request and response(s).
    • Candidates Token Count - Number of tokens in the response(s).
  • Action Status - An object with the following fields:
    • Code - If the request is executed successfully, code will be set to 0 but if the request failed, code will be set to 1.
    • Message - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_hub_flow"><sys_hub_flow action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><acls/><active>false</active><allow_high_security_roles>false</allow_high_security_roles><annotation/><attributes>browserActivatedIn=firefox,integrationActivatedIn=standalone,labelCacheCleanUpExecuted=true,timeFromCreateToActivate=24950777000,viewActivatedIn=naturalLanguage</attributes><authored_on_release_version>26000</authored_on_release_version><callable_by_client_api>false</callable_by_client_api><category display_value="Chat Completions Management">288753d543253110fce343852db8f2a0</category><copied_from>8a001394ff402210ba6effffffffff4c</copied_from><copied_from_name>Chat Completions Wrapper - Verte</copied_from_name><description><style>
    .mandatory::after {
        content: "* ";
        color: red;
    }
</style>
<p>Generates a response from the model given an input prompt. </p>
<p>
    <strong>Inputs:</strong>
</p>
<ul>
    <li>
        <strong class="mandatory">Model </strong> - The name of the model to use for generating the response.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong class="mandatory">Transaction ID </strong> - The transaction ID.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Content </strong> - Prompt object with the following fields for which the response is generated.
    </li>
    <ul>
        <li>
            <strong class="mandatory">Role</strong> - The role in a conversation associated with the content. Acceptable values include USER, MODEL.
        </li>

        <li>
            <strong class="mandatory">Text</strong> - The text instructions or chat dialogue to include in the prompt.
        </li>

    </ul>
    <li>
        <strong>Safety Settings</strong> - A list of unique SafetySetting instances with following fields for blocking unsafe content.
    </li>
    <ul>
        <li>
            <strong>Category</strong> - The category for this setting.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Threshold</strong> - Controls the probability threshold at which harm is blocked.
        </li>
    </ul>
    <li>
        <strong>Generation Config</strong> - Object with following fields specifying the configuration for generating the response.
    </li>
    <ul>
        <li>
            <strong>Temperature</strong> - Controls the randomness of selecting the next token during text generation. Lower values reduce randomness.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Top P</strong> - The maximum cumulative probability of tokens to consider when sampling.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Top K</strong> - The maximum number of tokens to consider when sampling.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Stop Sequences</strong> - The set of character sequences (up to 5) that will stop output generation.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Max Output Tokens</strong> - The maximum number of tokens to include in a candidate.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Candidate Count</strong> - The number of response variations to return. Value must be 1.
        </li>
    </ul>
    <li>
        <strong>Enable Retry Policy</strong> - Set to true to enable the retry policy.
    </li>
</ul>
<p>
    <strong>Outputs:</strong>
</p>
<ul>

    <li>
        <strong>Content</strong> - The response object from the model with the following fields.
        <ul>
            <li>
                <strong>Role</strong> - The role in the conversation associated with the content.
            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>Text</strong> - The generated text.
            </li>
        </ul>
    </li>
  <li>
        <strong>Finish Reason</strong> - The reason why the model stopped generating tokens.
    </li>
  <li>
        <strong>Safety Ratings</strong> - An array of Safety Rating objects with the following fields.
    </li>
    <ul>
        <li>
            <strong>Category</strong> - The safety category to configure a threshold for.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Threshold</strong> - The confidence scores of the each category, higher value means higher confidence.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Blocked</strong> - A flag indicating if the model's input or output was blocked.
        </li>
    </ul>
    <li>
        <strong>Citation Metadata</strong> - Citation information for model-generated output.
    </li>
    <ul>
        <li>
            <strong>Citations</strong> - List of citations to sources for a specific response.
        </li>
        <ul>
            <li>
                <strong>Start Index</strong> - Start of segment of the response that is attributed to this source, measured in bytes.
            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>End Index</strong> - End of the attributed segment, exclusive.
            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>URI</strong> - URI that is attributed as a source for a portion of the text.
            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>License</strong> - License for the GitHub project that is attributed as a source for segment.
            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>Title</strong> - Title associated with this citation. If present, it refers to the title of the source of this citation.
            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>Publication Date</strong> - Publication date associated with this citation. If present, it refers to the date at which the source of this citation was published.
            </li>
        </ul>
    </ul>
    
    <li>
        <strong>Usage Metadata</strong> - Usage Metadata object with the following fields:
        <ul>
            <li>
                <strong>Prompt Token Count</strong> - Number of tokens in the request.
            </li>
            
            <li>
                <strong>Total Token Count</strong> - Number of tokens in the request and response(s).
            </li>
          <li>
                <strong>Candidates Token Count</strong> - Number of tokens in the response(s).
            </li>
        </ul>
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Action Status</strong> - An object with the following fields: <ul>
            <li>
                <strong>Code</strong> - If the request is executed successfully, code will be set to 0 but if the request failed, code will be set to 1.
            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>Message</strong> - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.
            </li>
        </ul>
    </li>
</ul></description><display_name_after_preview/><flow_priority>MEDIUM</flow_priority><generation_source/><internal_name>chat_completions_sse_wrapper_vertex_ai</internal_name><label_cache>[{"name":"subflow.system_instruction","label":"Input➛System display_value="Chat Completions Management">288753d543253110fce343852db8f2a0</category><copied_from>8a001394ff402210ba6effffffffff4c</copied_from><copied_from_name/><description><style>
    .mandatory::after {
        content: "* ";
        color: red;
    }
</style>
<p>Generates a response from the model given an input prompt. </p>
<p>
    <strong>Inputs:</strong>
</p>
<ul>
    <li>
        <strong class="mandatory">Model </strong> - The name of the model to use for generating the response.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong class="mandatory">Transaction ID </strong> - The transaction ID.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Content </strong> - Prompt object with the following fields for which the response is generated.
    </li>
    <ul>
        <li>
            <strong class="mandatory">Role</strong> - The role in a conversation associated with the content. Acceptable values include USER, MODEL.
        </li>

        <li>
            <strong class="mandatory">Text</strong> - The text instructions or chat dialogue to include in the prompt.
        </li>

    </ul>
    <li>
        <strong>Safety Settings</strong> - A list of unique SafetySetting instances with following fields for blocking unsafe content.
    </li>
    <ul>
        <li>
            <strong>Category</strong> - The category for this setting.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Threshold</strong> - Controls the probability threshold at which harm is blocked.
        </li>
    </ul>
    <li>
        <strong>Generation Config</strong> - Object with following fields specifying the configuration for generating the response.
    </li>
    <ul>
        <li>
            <strong>Temperature</strong> - Controls the randomness of selecting the next token during text generation. Lower values reduce randomness.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Top P</strong> - The maximum cumulative probability of tokens to consider when sampling.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Top K</strong> - The maximum number of tokens to consider when sampling.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Stop Sequences</strong> - The set of character sequences (up to 5) that will stop output generation.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Max Output Tokens</strong> - The maximum number of tokens to include in a candidate.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Candidate Count</strong> - The number of response variations to return. Value must be 1.
        </li>
    </ul>
    <li>
        <strong>Enable Retry Policy</strong> - Set to true to enable the retry policy.
    </li>
</ul>
<p>
    <strong>Outputs:</strong>
</p>
<ul>

    <li>
        <strong>Content</strong> - The response object from the model with the following fields.
        <ul>
            <li>
                <strong>Role</strong> - The role in the conversation associated with the content.
            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>Text</strong> - The generated text.
            </li>
        </ul>
    </li>
  <li>
        <strong>Finish Reason</strong> - The reason why the model stopped generating tokens.
    </li>
  <li>
        <strong>Safety Ratings</strong> - An array of Safety Rating objects with the following fields.
    </li>
    <ul>
        <li>
            <strong>Category</strong> - The safety category to configure a threshold for.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Threshold</strong> - The confidence scores of the each category, higher value means higher confidence.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Blocked</strong> - A flag indicating if the model's input or output was blocked.
        </li>
    </ul>
    <li>
        <strong>Citation Metadata</strong> - Citation information for model-generated output.
    </li>
    <ul>
        <li>
            <strong>Citations</strong> - List of citations to sources for a specific response.
        </li>
        <ul>
            <li>
                <strong>Start Index</strong> - Start of segment of the response that is attributed to this source, measured in bytes.
            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>End Index</strong> - End of the attributed segment, exclusive.
            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>URI</strong> - URI that is attributed as a source for a portion of the text.
            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>License</strong> - License for the GitHub project that is attributed as a source for segment.
            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>Title</strong> - Title associated with this citation. If present, it refers to the title of the source of this citation.
            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>Publication Date</strong> - Publication date associated with this citation. If present, it refers to the date at which the source of this citation was published.
            </li>
        </ul>
    </ul>
    
    <li>
        <strong>Usage Metadata</strong> - Usage Metadata object with the following fields:
